title: The spectral sequence of a filtered complex
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category and let $K^\bullet$ be a complex equipped with a bounded decreasing filtration $F^\bullet K^\bullet$ by subcomplexes [def-sp-filtration]. Put $X^{[p,q]}=F^pK^\bullet/F^qK^\bullet$ for $p\le q$. Then there is a cohomological spectral sequence $(E_r^{p,q},d_r)_{r\ge1}$ with $E_1^{p,q}=H^{p+q}(X^{[p,p+1]})=H^{p+q}(\operatorname{gr}^pK^\bullet)$ and $d_r:E_r^{p,q}\to E_r^{p+r,q-r+1}$; $d_1$ is the connecting map of $0\to X^{[p+1,p+2]}\to X^{[p,p+2]}\to X^{[p,p+1]}\to0$. For every $r\ge1$, inside $\operatorname{gr}^pK^{p+q}$, $Z_r^{p,q}=((F^pK^{p+q}\cap d^{-1}(F^{p+r}K^{p+q+1}))+F^{p+1}K^{p+q})/F^{p+1}K^{p+q}$ and $B_r^{p,q}=((F^pK^{p+q}\cap d(F^{p-r+1}K^{p+q-1}))+F^{p+1}K^{p+q})/F^{p+1}K^{p+q}$, with $B_r\subseteq Z_r$ and $E_r^{p,q}\cong Z_r^{p,q}/B_r^{p,q}$. Equivalently, the same object is naturally isomorphic to the image of $H^{p+q}(X^{[p,p+r]})\to H^{p+q}(X^{[p-r+1,p+1]})$ induced by the map $F^pK^\bullet/F^{p+r}K^\bullet\to F^{p-r+1}K^\bullet/F^{p+1}K^\bullet$. The induced image filtration on $H^n(K^\bullet)$ is finite and separated, and $E_\infty^{p,q}\cong\operatorname{gr}^pH^{p+q}(K^\bullet)$, so the sequence converges [def-sp-convergence]. The construction is functorial. If $F^pK=K$ for $p\le0$ and $H^i(\operatorname{gr}^pK)=0$ outside $i\in[p,p+1]$, then $E_r^{p,q}=0$ unless $p,q\ge0$ and terms stabilize for $r>\max(p,q)+1$.

proof.text: The short exact sequences $0\to F^{p+1}K\to F^pK\to\operatorname{gr}^pK\to0$ give the displayed long exact cohomology sequences by [lem-sp-long-exact-of-triangle].

These sequences form an E1-indexed couple with $\alpha$ of bidegree $(-1,+1)$, $g$ of $(0,0)$, and connecting $f$ of $(+1,0)$. Reindexing by $(P,Q)=(2p+q,-p)$ changes these to the standard exact-couple bidegrees $(-1,+1),(+2,-1),(0,0)$ of [def-sp-exact-couple]. The standard couple therefore starts at its $E_2=E_1^{filtered}$; the filtered $E_1$ is the initial graded page.

After this reindexing, the derived couples give [def-sp-spectral-sequence] with standard differential bidegree $(+R,1-R)$ on standard page $R$; standard page $R$ corresponds to filtered page $r=R-1$ (so standard $E_2$ is filtered $E_1$), and this translates back to filtered bidegree $(+r,1-r)$ in $(p,q)$; page homology is identified by [lem-sp-page-induction]. The first differential is the connecting map from Step 1, not a derived-couple definition of E1.

The filtered-complex cycle and boundary calculation [lem-sp-filtered-complex-ZB-description] gives exactly the displayed $Z_r,B_r$ subobjects and $E_r=Z_r/B_r$. Its well-typed quotient-complex clause identifies this object with the image of $H^{p+q}(X^{[p,p+r]})$ in $H^{p+q}(X^{[p-r+1,p+1]})$; at $r=1$, $Z_1$ and $B_1$ are respectively the cycles and boundaries of $\operatorname{gr}^pK$, so $E_1=H(\operatorname{gr}^pK)$, and boundedness gives stabilization for large r.

The bounded image filtration on cohomology is finite and separated. In the convergence convention [def-sp-convergence], its filtration index $P=p+n$ is the shifted version of the filtered index $p$ in total degree $n$. The stabilization and associated-graded identification from Step 4 give convergence in that sense.

Filtered maps induce maps of the couples and hence compatible page maps by [lem-sp-couple-morphism]. The first-quadrant vanishing and stabilization follow directly from the translated differential bidegree and the stated support bounds.
